meta.integrationPrinciple: History is a secondary branch under /history, not the central identity of carpmasons.ca.

events.title: Dispensation issued
events.summary: Dispensation issued to form Carleton Lodge at Carp in Ottawa District No. 16.

events.title: Carleton Lodge instituted
events.summary: Carleton Lodge was instituted with 23 charter members.

events.title: First applications
events.summary: First three applications for initiation and two for affiliation were received and balloted on.

events.title: Warrant No. 465 issued
events.summary: Warrant for Carleton Lodge No. 465 was signed and dated July 20, 1904.

events.title: Lodge consecrated
events.summary: Carleton Lodge was consecrated by R.W. Bro. Sidney Albert Luke.

events.title: Kidd Block destroyed by fire
events.summary: Fire destroyed the original Lodge rooms over the Carp Drug Store in the Kidd Block.

events.title: Orange Hall used temporarily
events.summary: The local Orange Lodge offered its hall to Carleton Lodge after the fire.

events.title: Memorial Hall financing effort
events.summary: A stock company sought to finance a memorial hall with an upper-storey Lodge room; funds were insufficient for the second storey.

events.title: Temporary Lodge in Russell's store
events.summary: By May 1923 the Lodge was housed temporarily in the upper portion of Bro. F. C. Russell's store.

events.title: Church Union creates opportunity
events.summary: The former Presbyterian congregation joined the Methodists under the United Church of Canada; Carleton Lodge later approached the congregation regarding the former church.

events.title: Church transfer agreement
events.summary: The former congregation agreed to deed the church and land to the Freemasons for $250 plus legal transfer fees. Exact deed date remains unresolved.

events.title: William Stuart offers to fund Le Havre acquisition
events.summary: Bro. William Stuart offered to pay expenses associated with acquiring the historic Le Havre furniture stored in London.

events.title: First meeting in present Temple
events.summary: Carleton Lodge held its first meeting in the present Masonic Temple.

events.title: Temple dedicated
events.summary: Grand Lodge formally dedicated the Masonic Temple at Carp.

events.title: La Loge Le Havre de Grâce consecrated
events.summary: The wartime Lodge at Le Havre was consecrated.

events.title: La Loge Le Havre de Grâce closes
WWI memorial tablet unveiled
events.summary: A memorial tablet was unveiled in Carleton Lodge by Lt.-Gen. Sir Sam Hughes.

events.title: Formal centennial celebration
events.summary: Ottawa District history records Carleton Lodge's formal centennial celebration on this date.
